mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 60 degrees under clear skies along the Military Ridge State Trail, with the moon currently in a waxing gibbous phase.

The City of Verona is looking for a new Engineering Technician for the Department of Public Works to help manage our infrastructure projects. Also, please note that new utility rates for sewer and stormwater were recently approved to ensure these vital services remain self-supporting.

There is plenty to do, with live music today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
In police news, on Friday, August 15, officers successfully located a missing seven-year-old child in the Westridge Estates neighborhood and safely reunited the child with their parents.

Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Cashew. The shop is currently closed but opens at 10 AM, and you can also find Kona Ice at Fireman's Park today from 11 AM to 5 PM or the Verona Youth Football stadium from 1 PM to 7:30 PM.
